cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll fix the kettle for a spoonful of yesterday. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I give you yesterday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Start with the five minutes you wasted this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave it overnight. I can wait for the currency to mature.

mechanism: A prices kettle repair in past time, accepts a smaller recent unit and extends payment while fixing the kettle first.
confusable: Unlike simply asking for a favor later, the owed currency is a spoonful of a day that must age before collection.
comparison: Credit for maturing minutes differs from borrowing a shadow only outside office hours.
seedUse: D166-b spoonful yesterday, wasted minutes and overnight aging; S02-b offers service before payment to keep the deal workable.
